text: too big to hold comfortably in my hands, not impressed. I have the one that this is a knock off from.  This one does not easily allow you to put a slim can in.  This model wants you to unscrew the top, put your can inside, and then screw the top back on.  My original one allows the can to go in and out with removing the top.  This model also has no air holes making it next to impossible to insert or remove the can while the lid is on.  This model is also much larger in diameter than my name brand one.  It is too big to be comfortable in my hands.
